name: P1015: the condition hits are always 0 (test_matching.TheMatchersTest.test_condition_hits_count_functions_and_tags_only, test_needs.TheConditionOrdersTest)
find: return sum(1 for word in condition_words(need.get("condition")) if word in held)

name: P1015: an offer's names count for the condition (test_matching.TheMatchersTest.test_condition_hits_count_functions_and_tags_only)
find: for f in offer.functions if f.get("does") == need.get("does")] + list(offer.tags)
replace: for f in offer.functions if f.get("does") == need.get("does")] + list(offer.tags) + list(offer.names)

name: P1015: an offer's about text counts for the condition (test_matching.TheMatchersTest.test_condition_hits_count_functions_and_tags_only)
find: for f in offer.functions if f.get("does") == need.get("does")] + list(offer.tags)
replace: for f in offer.functions if f.get("does") == need.get("does")] + list(offer.tags) + [offer.about]

name: P1015: a function of every verb counts for the condition (test_matching.TheMatchersTest.test_condition_hits_count_functions_and_tags_only)
find: for f in offer.functions if f.get("does") == need.get("does")] + list(offer.tags)

name: P1015: a hyphen splits a condition word (test_matching.TheWordsTest.test_condition_words_keep_a_hyphenated_word_and_drop_one_letter)
find: for word in re.split(r"[^a-z0-9-]+", str(text or "").lower())]
replace: for word in re.split(r"[^a-z0-9]+", str(text or "").lower())]

name: P1015: a one-letter condition word stays (test_matching.TheWordsTest.test_condition_words_keep_a_hyphenated_word_and_drop_one_letter)
find: return list(dict.fromkeys(fold(word) for word in found if len(word) > 1 and word not in FILLER))
replace: return list(dict.fromkeys(fold(word) for word in found if len(word) > 0 and word not in FILLER))
